scraped.scraped_description: Plausible is a lightweight and open-source Google Analytics alternative. Your website data is 100% yours and the privacy of your visitors is respected.

name: Plausible Analytics
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on EU infrastructure and data residency requirements
awards: Product Hunt recognition for privacy-focused analytics
documented_limitations: Limited real-time reporting compared to Google Analytics
Smaller feature set than enterprise analytics platforms
Smaller user base means less community-contributed integrations
failure_modes: Service outages could impact website analytics for paying customers
contributor_governance: Open source contribution guidelines on GitHub; community-driven feature requests via GitHub discussions
ai_involvement: Monitors traffic from AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude)
political_relevance_summary: Plausible Analytics addresses digital rights and online freedoms. Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides digital rights infrastructure or privacy-preserving technology foundations.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication; already deployed across multiple jurisdictions.
